props.title: Solid sphere

props.title: Solid cylinder

props.title: Thin-walled tube

props.title: Box

props.title: Solid cone

props.title: Block

props.title: Beam / plank

props.title: Ladder

props.title: Wheel

props.title: Pulley

props.title: Gyroscope

props.title: Turntable

props.title: Spinning top

props.title: Bead on a rotating hoop

props.title: Cart
props.description: Wheeled cart; wheels roll on the base of its size.

props.title: Train car

props.title: Elevator car

props.title: Projectile + launcher
props.description: Ball at the launch point with a cannon at the launch angle.

props.title: Rocket
props.description: Rocket body, nozzle and fins (variable mass, thrust).

props.title: Pendulum
props.description: Pivot pin, string or rod and bob; ceiling block above the pin.

props.title: Spring

props.title: Rope / string
props.description: Rope segment between two points.

props.title: Hinge
props.description: Knuckled barrel on the axis with a fixed leaf.

props.title: Pivot stand
props.description: Pedestal and socket; origin at the pivot point.

props.title: Support
props.description: Hatched ceiling, floor or wall slab; origin on its working face.

props.title: Wedge
props.description: Movable right-triangle wedge (slope from base/height or angle).

props.title: Ramp
props.description: Fixed incline with a running strip and hatch.

props.title: Rail
props.description: I-profile rail along x; running surface at y = 0.

props.title: Track
props.description: Twin-rail track: loop-the-loop, quarter bowl, half-pipe or custom path.

props.title: Planet / moon / star
props.description: Banded planet with axis and equator; moon (lit half) or star.

props.title: Orbit
props.description: Ellipse with the attracting body at a focus; diagram only.

props.title: Reference frame
props.description: x y z axis triad (problem axes or body axes).

families.title: Units, dimensional analysis and limiting cases
families.motion: none: reasoning about scales and limits
invariants: each term has the same units
limits must reduce to known simple cases
families.coordinate_frame: none
families.gap: No visual needed; strategy chapter.

families.title: Static equilibrium: sticks, ladders, leaning bodies
families.motion: none: the body stays at rest; forces and torques balance
invariants: friction <= mu N at each contact
families.coordinate_frame: planar x right, y up; torques about z out of the page

families.title: Ropes and chains in equilibrium (catenary, rope on a plane, wrapped rope)
families.motion: none: tension varies along the rope; each small piece is in equilibrium
invariants: dT balances the weight and normal force of each piece
horizontal tension is constant on a hanging chain
families.coordinate_frame: planar x right, y up
families.gap: Static shape drawn as a curve; no rope dynamics.

families.title: Block on a fixed incline (friction, sliding, sideways)
families.motion: 1D sliding along the slope; may stay at rest when friction suffices
invariants: a = g(sin theta - mu cos theta) while sliding
families.coordinate_frame: tilted x down the slope, y along the normal; or world x right, y up

families.title: Block on a movable or accelerating wedge
families.motion: block slides down while the wedge recoils (or is driven)
invariants: horizontal momentum conserved when the floor is frictionless
block stays on the wedge surface
families.coordinate_frame: world x right, y up; relative coordinates along the wedge face

families.title: Atwood machines and pulley systems (massless and massive pulleys)
families.motion: masses move vertically, tied by an inextensible string; a massive pulley turns without slipping
invariants: a = r alpha for a non-slipping string
tension differs across a massive pulley
families.coordinate_frame: vertical y up per mass; pulley angle about z
families.gap: Double/infinite/ring-of-pulleys variants are not prepared.

families.title: Projectile motion without drag

source_refs.label: Throwing a ball from a cliff

families.motion: parabolic flight under constant gravity
families.coordinate_frame: world x horizontal, y up, origin at the launch point
families.gap: Drag, wind and inclined-landing variants are not prepared.

families.title: Velocity-dependent forces and drag in 1D
families.motion: speed approaches a terminal value; exponential or tanh approach
invariants: quadratic drag: v = v_t tanh(g t / v_t)
families.coordinate_frame: 1D vertical axis, down positive
families.gap: Graph only; no simulated drag body.

families.title: Circular motion: conical pendulum, banking, curves
families.motion: uniform motion on a horizontal circle; the net force points to the centre
invariants: T cos alpha = mg for a conical pendulum
families.coordinate_frame: world x, y horizontal, z up; polar r, theta for the planar view
families.gap: Banked tracks and motorcycles are not prepared scenes.

families.title: Rolling wheels: velocities of points and radius of curvature
families.motion: the wheel rolls without slipping; each point traces a cycloid
families.coordinate_frame: world x along the road, y up
families.gap: Kinematics only; the rolling recipes in chapter 8 show the dynamics.

families.title: Spring oscillators: simple, damped and driven
families.motion: oscillation about equilibrium; damping makes the amplitude decay
invariants: energy exchanges between kinetic and spring
families.coordinate_frame: 1D x along the spring, origin at equilibrium
families.gap: Resonance curves and driven steady states are not prepared.

families.title: Coupled oscillators and normal modes
families.motion: two masses exchange energy; normal modes move in fixed ratios
invariants: normal modes oscillate at single frequencies
families.coordinate_frame: 1D x along the springs, one coordinate per mass

families.title: Simple pendulum (small and large swings, peg, moving support)
families.motion: swing about a fixed pivot under gravity
invariants: tension = mg cos theta + m v^2/L
families.coordinate_frame: world x right, y up, origin at the pivot; theta from downward vertical
families.gap: Oscillating or free supports are not prepared.

families.title: Double pendulum and coupled swings
families.motion: two linked swings; chaotic at large angles
families.coordinate_frame: world x right, y up; two angles from the vertical

families.title: Energy, potentials and small oscillations about equilibrium
families.motion: motion in a potential well; turning points where E = V
families.coordinate_frame: 1D coordinate x (or angle) with V(x) plotted above it
families.gap: Shown as an energy graph, not a simulated track.

families.title: Sliding or rolling off a sphere or hemisphere
families.motion: moves over a curved top until the normal force vanishes
invariants: energy conserved up to that point
cos theta = 2/3 for a sliding particle
families.coordinate_frame: world x right, y up; angle from the top of the sphere

families.title: Gravitation of spheres and shells, escape speed, tunnels through planets
families.motion: radial motion in g(r); harmonic inside a uniform planet
invariants: g proportional to r inside a uniform sphere
families.coordinate_frame: radial coordinate r from the planet's centre
families.gap: Graph of g(r); no orbital simulation.

families.title: Variable mass: rockets, leaky buckets, chains, raindrops
families.motion: mass enters or leaves the system; momentum flux matters
invariants: F = dp/dt for the whole system
families.coordinate_frame: 1D axis along the motion
families.gap: No variable-mass engine; catalog only.

families.title: Collisions: elastic, inelastic, billiards and bouncing
families.motion: brief contact exchanges momentum; elastic keeps kinetic energy
invariants: elastic: equal masses leave at right angles
families.coordinate_frame: table x, y seen from above; CM frame for analysis
families.gap: Many-ball and bouncing-between-surfaces variants are not prepared.

families.title: Constrained systems solved with the Lagrangian (beads, sticks, springs on frames)
families.motion: motion along a constraint; generalized coordinates
invariants: E conserved when L has no explicit t
conjugate momentum conserved for an ignorable coordinate
families.coordinate_frame: the chosen generalized coordinates
families.gap: No prepared scenes; most need rotating or moving constraints.

families.title: Calculus of variations: shortest paths, minimal surfaces, brachistochrone
families.motion: none: comparing whole paths
families.coordinate_frame: x, y of the curve
families.gap: Math only; no prepared visual.

families.title: Central forces, orbits and the effective potential
families.motion: r(t) moves between turning points of V_eff; L conserved
invariants: circular orbit at the minimum of V_eff
families.coordinate_frame: polar r, theta in the orbital plane
families.gap: Graph only; no orbit integrator in the library.

families.title: Moments of inertia by integration, parallel axes and symmetry

source_refs.label: Slick calculations of I for fractal objects

families.motion: rotation about the remaining end pivot after release
invariants: I = integral of r_perp^2 dm about the axis
parallel axis: I = I_cm + M d^2
families.coordinate_frame: body coordinates with the axis marked; x along the rod from the pin

families.title: Rotation about a fixed axis: falling sticks, physical pendulums, chimneys
families.motion: rotation about a fixed pin under gravity
invariants: pivot force from the CM acceleration
families.coordinate_frame: world x right, y up; angle about z through the pivot

families.title: Sliding ladders and leaning bodies falling
families.motion: ends slide on frictionless surfaces until contact is lost
invariants: CM moves on a circle while both contacts hold
the ladder leaves the wall at 2/3 of its initial height
families.coordinate_frame: world x along the floor, y up the wall
families.gap: Not prepared: frictionless sliding contacts need a careful engine scene and checks.

families.title: Rolling without slipping: inclines, spools, cylinders on boards
families.motion: the contact point is at rest; friction makes rolling
families.coordinate_frame: tilted x down the slope, y along the normal; rotation about z
families.gap: Board-and-cylinder systems are not prepared.

families.title: Sliding to rolling and spin from friction (struck balls, paper pulls, coupled disks)
families.motion: kinetic friction acts until the contact point stops slipping
invariants: angular momentum about the contact point conserved
rolling at v = 5/7 v0 for a struck ball
families.coordinate_frame: world x along the table, y up (or top view)

families.title: Angular impulse: balls hitting sticks, centre of percussion
families.motion: a brief blow changes both v_CM and omega
invariants: linear and angular momentum about the CM changed by the impulse
centre of percussion has no recoil
families.coordinate_frame: table x, y seen from above; impact point measured from the CM
families.gap: Bouncing-under-table and brick variants not prepared.

families.title: Inertia tensor and principal axes

source_refs.label: Existence of principal axes for a pancake
Symmetries and principal axes for a pancake

families.motion: none: the body is drawn at rest
invariants: principal axes: L parallel to omega

families.coordinate_frame: body x', y', z' (given coordinates) versus principal e1, e2, e3

families.title: Rotation about a fixed axis in 3D: L not parallel to omega
families.motion: the body turns at constant omega about a fixed axle
invariants: L swings around with the body
families.coordinate_frame: world z along the axle; body x' y' z' turn with the body

families.title: Torque-free bodies: free tops and the tennis racket theorem
families.motion: free rotation; stable about the largest and smallest principal axes
families.coordinate_frame: world x, y, z fixed; body principal axes turn

families.title: Heavy tops: precession and nutation

source_refs.label: Heavy top on a slippery table

families.motion: the tilted axis precesses and nods under gravity's torque
families.coordinate_frame: world z up; Euler angles theta (tilt from +z), phi (azimuth), psi (spin)

families.title: Rolling in 3D: cones, coins, lollipops, hurricane balls
families.motion: rolling contact with a precessing axis
invariants: omega along the line of points at rest
families.coordinate_frame: world z up; e3 = body symmetry axis
families.gap: These library recipes are representative. See Study path for exact rolling-coin/lollipop references; there is no general 3D rolling-contact solver.

families.title: Rotating frames: centrifugal and Coriolis forces
families.motion: motion as seen from a turning frame
families.coordinate_frame: rotating x', y' fixed to the turntable; inertial X, Y
families.gap: Diagram from the analytic solution; no rotating-frame simulation.

families.title: Bead on a rotating hoop

source_refs.label: Another bead on a rotating hoop

families.motion: the undamped bead oscillates about a stable equilibrium set by the spin rate

families.title: Tides, Roche limit and the shape of the earth
families.motion: none: static tidal and centrifugal stretching
families.coordinate_frame: earth-centred x toward the moon

families.title: Relativity kinematics: time dilation, length contraction, trains and tunnels
families.motion: events in two frames; worldlines on a Minkowski diagram
invariants: interval c^2 t^2 - x^2 is invariant
simultaneity depends on the frame (L v / c^2)

families.title: Relativistic velocity addition and rapidity
families.motion: none: composing speeds

families.gap: Graph only.

families.title: Relativistic energy, momentum, collisions and decays
families.motion: none: conservation of 4-momentum
families.coordinate_frame: lab frame or CM frame
families.gap: Not prepared; momentum diagrams would be illustrations.

families.motion: hyperbolic worldlines; clocks run at different rates by height
families.coordinate_frame: spacetime (x, ct); height h in the field
families.gap: Graph only.

recipes.title: Block on a rough incline
recipes.description: A block of mass m slides down a fixed incline of angle θ with kinetic friction coefficient μ, starting from rest.
recipes.motion: 1D sliding along the slope; may stay at rest when friction suffices
recipes.coordinate_frame: tilted x down the slope, y along the normal; or world x right, y up
recipes.purpose: Resolve gravity along a slope and compare it with friction to predict whether the block slides.

recipes.title: Block on a free wedge
recipes.description: A block of mass m is released on the frictionless slope (angle θ) of a wedge of mass M that can slide freely on a frictionless floor.
recipes.motion: block slides down while the wedge recoils (or is driven)
recipes.coordinate_frame: world x right, y up; relative coordinates along the wedge face
recipes.purpose: See why the wedge recoils when the block slides: horizontal momentum is shared.

recipes.title: Atwood machine with a massive pulley
recipes.description: Two masses hang from a string over a uniform disk pulley of mass M and radius R that turns without friction; the string does not slip.
recipes.motion: masses move vertically, tied by an inextensible string; a massive pulley turns without slipping
recipes.coordinate_frame: vertical y up per mass; pulley angle about z
recipes.purpose: Compare the string forces when part of the falling energy turns a massive pulley.

recipes.title: Projectile launched at 45°
recipes.description: A ball is launched at speed v₀ and angle θ above the horizontal over level ground.

source_refs.label: Throwing a ball from a cliff

recipes.motion: parabolic flight under constant gravity
recipes.coordinate_frame: world x horizontal, y up, origin at the launch point
recipes.purpose: Connect horizontal motion and vertical acceleration to one curved flight path.

recipes.title: Damped mass on a spring
recipes.description: A mass on a spring (stiffness k) with linear damping is pulled x₀ from equilibrium and released.
recipes.motion: oscillation about equilibrium; damping makes the amplitude decay
recipes.coordinate_frame: 1D x along the spring, origin at equilibrium
recipes.purpose: Compare the oscillation with its shrinking amplitude as damping removes energy.

recipes.title: Two masses between three springs
recipes.description: Two equal masses on a frictionless line are joined to each other and to two walls by three identical springs.
recipes.motion: two masses exchange energy; normal modes move in fixed ratios
recipes.coordinate_frame: 1D x along the springs, one coordinate per mass
recipes.purpose: See how two connected masses exchange energy and form normal modes.

recipes.title: Pendulum released from a large angle
recipes.description: A small bob on a light rigid rod of length L is released from rest at angle θ₀ from the vertical.
recipes.motion: swing about a fixed pivot under gravity
recipes.coordinate_frame: world x right, y up, origin at the pivot; theta from downward vertical
recipes.purpose: Relate the restoring torque to the changing direction and speed of a swinging mass.

recipes.title: Double pendulum
recipes.description: Two equal point masses hang in series on two light rods of equal length.
recipes.motion: two linked swings; chaotic at large angles
recipes.coordinate_frame: world x right, y up; two angles from the vertical
recipes.purpose: Follow two linked angles and see why their motion cannot be treated as two independent swings.

recipes.title: Ladder against a smooth wall
recipes.description: A uniform ladder leans at angle θ to the floor against a frictionless wall.
recipes.motion: none: the body stays at rest; forces and torques balance
recipes.coordinate_frame: planar x right, y up; torques about z out of the page
recipes.purpose: Locate the weight, wall reaction and floor friction, then balance forces and torques.

recipes.title: Solid ball rolling down an incline
recipes.description: A uniform solid ball rolls without slipping from rest down a fixed incline of angle θ.
recipes.motion: the contact point is at rest; friction makes rolling
recipes.coordinate_frame: tilted x down the slope, y along the normal; rotation about z
recipes.purpose: Separate motion of the centre from rotation and identify the contact point at rest.

recipes.title: Falling rod about a pivot
recipes.description: A uniform rod is pinned at one end and released from rest horizontal.
recipes.motion: rotation about a fixed pin under gravity
recipes.coordinate_frame: world x right, y up; angle about z through the pivot
recipes.purpose: Follow the changing gravity torque as a rod turns about its fixed end.

recipes.title: Physical pendulum
recipes.description: A uniform rod hangs from a pin at one end and is released at angle θ₀ from vertical.
recipes.motion: rotation about a fixed pin under gravity
recipes.coordinate_frame: world x right, y up; angle about z through the pivot
recipes.purpose: Compare a swinging rigid body with a point pendulum using its moment of inertia.

recipes.title: Struck ball: slipping, then rolling
recipes.description: A billiard ball at rest is struck horizontally through its centre.
recipes.motion: kinetic friction acts until the contact point stops slipping
recipes.coordinate_frame: world x along the table, y up (or top view)
recipes.purpose: Watch friction change both sliding speed and spin until rolling without slipping begins.

recipes.title: Disk dropped onto a turntable
recipes.description: A disk at rest is dropped onto a spinning turntable; kinetic friction torques them toward a common ω while angular momentum is kept and energy is lost.
recipes.motion: kinetic friction acts until the contact point stops slipping
recipes.coordinate_frame: world x along the table, y up (or top view)
recipes.purpose: See how friction transfers angular momentum between touching rotating disks.

recipes.title: Ball hits a free stick
recipes.description: On a frictionless table, a ball strikes a free uniform stick at rest, perpendicular to it and a distance b from its centre; the collision is elastic.
recipes.motion: a brief blow changes both v_CM and omega
recipes.coordinate_frame: table x, y seen from above; impact point measured from the CM
recipes.purpose: Separate an impact into motion of the centre of mass and rotation about it.

recipes.title: Pulling a spool
recipes.description: A spool (outer radius R, drum radius r) rests on a rough floor.
recipes.motion: the contact point is at rest; friction makes rolling
recipes.coordinate_frame: tilted x down the slope, y along the normal; rotation about z
recipes.purpose: Compare the pull direction, torque and rolling direction of a spool on a rough floor.

recipes.title: Ball rolling off a sphere
recipes.description: A small solid ball starts almost at rest on top of a large fixed sphere and rolls without slipping.
recipes.motion: moves over a curved top until the normal force vanishes
recipes.coordinate_frame: world x right, y up; angle from the top of the sphere
recipes.purpose: Find the point where contact ends because the normal force reaches zero.

recipes.title: Billiard balls separate at 90°
recipes.description: A ball moving at speed v strikes an identical ball at rest off-centre; the collision is elastic and frictionless.
recipes.motion: brief contact exchanges momentum; elastic keeps kinetic energy
recipes.coordinate_frame: table x, y seen from above; CM frame for analysis
recipes.purpose: Compare outgoing momentum directions after an elastic collision of equal masses.

recipes.title: Uniform rod released about one end
recipes.description: A uniform rod of mass M and length ℓ rests horizontally on supports at both ends.

source_refs.label: Slick calculations of I for fractal objects

recipes.motion: rotation about the remaining end pivot after release
recipes.coordinate_frame: body coordinates with the axis marked; x along the rod from the pin
recipes.purpose: See how moving the rotation axis changes a rod’s moment of inertia.

recipes.title: Hurricane balls: rolling without slipping
recipes.description: Two uniform spheres (mass m, radius R each) are fused into 'hurricane balls'.
recipes.motion: rolling contact with a precessing axis
recipes.coordinate_frame: world z up; e3 = body symmetry axis
recipes.purpose: Compare the spin and precession of a rolling pair with its instantaneous contact axis.

recipes.title: Conical pendulum
recipes.description: A bob on a light string of length L moves in a horizontal circle with the string at a constant angle α from the vertical.
recipes.motion: uniform motion on a horizontal circle; the net force points to the centre
recipes.coordinate_frame: world x, y horizontal, z up; polar r, theta for the planar view
recipes.purpose: Resolve tension into weight support and the inward force needed for circular motion.

recipes.title: Top released without precession: nutation
recipes.description: A symmetric top spins fast about its axis, tilted θ₀ from the vertical with its tip fixed, and is released with no precession.

source_refs.label: Heavy top on a slippery table

recipes.motion: the tilted axis precesses and nods under gravity's torque
recipes.coordinate_frame: world z up; Euler angles theta (tilt from +z), phi (azimuth), psi (spin)
recipes.purpose: Distinguish precession from nutation and connect both to gravity’s torque.

recipes.title: Tennis racket theorem
recipes.description: A rigid box with three different principal moments is thrown spinning about its intermediate axis, with a tiny wobble.
recipes.motion: free rotation; stable about the largest and smallest principal axes
recipes.coordinate_frame: world x, y, z fixed; body principal axes turn
recipes.purpose: Compare stable principal-axis rotation with the unstable intermediate-axis flip.

recipes.title: Wobbling coin in free flight
recipes.description: A thin uniform disk is thrown spinning about an axis slightly off its symmetry axis, with no torque.
recipes.motion: free rotation; stable about the largest and smallest principal axes
recipes.coordinate_frame: world x, y, z fixed; body principal axes turn
recipes.purpose: Compare angular velocity ω with fixed angular momentum L. Watch the coin’s axis precess around L during torque-free wobble.

recipes.title: Inertia tensor of a cube
recipes.description: Find the inertia tensor of a uniform cube of side a about its centre, the moment about a body diagonal, and the moment about an edge.

source_refs.label: Existence of principal axes for a pancake
Symmetries and principal axes for a pancake

recipes.motion: none: the body is drawn at rest
recipes.coordinate_frame: body x', y', z' (given coordinates) versus principal e1, e2, e3
recipes.purpose: Compare a cube’s body axes with its principal axes and inertia tensor.

recipes.title: Tilted rod on a vertical axle
recipes.description: A uniform thin rod is fixed at its centre to a vertical axle at angle θ to it and turns at constant ω.
recipes.motion: the body turns at constant omega about a fixed axle
recipes.coordinate_frame: world z along the axle; body x' y' z' turn with the body
recipes.purpose: See why angular momentum can tilt away from angular velocity and require an axle torque.

recipes.title: Cone rolling on its side
recipes.description: A solid cone of half-angle α rolls without slipping on a table with its apex fixed, going around at rate Ω.
recipes.motion: rolling contact with a precessing axis
recipes.coordinate_frame: world z up; e3 = body symmetry axis
recipes.purpose: Identify the instantaneous rotation axis along the contact line of a rolling cone.

recipes.title: Shape of a hanging chain
recipes.description: A uniform flexible chain hangs between two supports.
recipes.motion: none: tension varies along the rope; each small piece is in equilibrium
recipes.coordinate_frame: planar x right, y up
recipes.purpose: Compare a hanging chain with the small-slope parabola by changing the tension scale.

recipes.title: Falling with air drag
recipes.description: An object falls from rest with drag proportional to v or to v².
recipes.motion: speed approaches a terminal value; exponential or tanh approach
recipes.coordinate_frame: 1D vertical axis, down positive
recipes.purpose: Compare linear and quadratic drag as falling speed approaches terminal speed.

recipes.title: Motion in a double-well potential
recipes.description: A particle moves in the potential V(x) = V₀((x/b)² − 1)².

recipes.coordinate_frame: 1D coordinate x (or angle) with V(x) plotted above it

recipes.title: Gravity inside and outside a planet
recipes.description: Find the gravitational field g(r) of a uniform spherical planet, inside and outside, and the motion through a tunnel along a diameter.
recipes.motion: radial motion in g(r); harmonic inside a uniform planet
recipes.coordinate_frame: radial coordinate r from the planet's centre
recipes.purpose: Compare gravity inside a uniform sphere with the inverse-square field outside it.

recipes.title: Effective potential for a Kepler orbit
recipes.description: A mass moves under the attractive force F = −k/r².
recipes.motion: r(t) moves between turning points of V_eff; L conserved
recipes.coordinate_frame: polar r, theta in the orbital plane
recipes.purpose: See how angular momentum changes the radial potential and the orbit’s turning points.

recipes.title: Bead on a spinning hoop
recipes.description: A bead slides without friction on a vertical hoop of radius R spinning at ω about its vertical diameter.

source_refs.label: Another bead on a rotating hoop

recipes.motion: the undamped bead oscillates about a stable equilibrium set by the spin rate
recipes.coordinate_frame: angle theta from the bottom of the hoop; hoop spins about vertical z

recipes.title: Relativistic velocity addition
recipes.description: A ball moves at u relative to a train moving at v.
recipes.motion: none: composing speeds
recipes.coordinate_frame: 1D along the track
recipes.purpose: Compare Galilean and relativistic velocity addition as the train speed changes.

recipes.title: Hyperbolic motion
recipes.description: A rocket starts from rest and keeps a constant proper acceleration g.
recipes.motion: hyperbolic worldlines; clocks run at different rates by height
recipes.coordinate_frame: spacetime (x, ct); height h in the field
recipes.purpose: Connect constant proper acceleration to a curved worldline in spacetime.

recipes.title: Free particle seen from a turntable
recipes.description: A puck slides outward from the centre of a frictionless turntable that spins at ω.
recipes.motion: motion as seen from a turning frame
recipes.coordinate_frame: rotating x', y' fixed to the turntable; inertial X, Y
recipes.purpose: Compare the same free motion in inertial and rotating coordinates.

recipes.title: Minkowski diagram for a moving train
